name: TWGL
role: Tiny WebGL helper: programs, buffers, uniforms and framebuffers with less boilerplate
summary: Small helper library over the raw WebGL API that creates programs, buffer info, textures and framebuffers from plain objects, then draws with setUniforms and drawBufferInfo. Output is a canvas, with no scene graph. Distinguishing strength: keeps raw WebGL control with a fraction of the boilerplate.
use_when: Over raw WebGL for a fullscreen fragment shader or multi-pass render-to-texture effect
Over regl when you want thin helpers around normal WebGL calls, not a new paradigm
Over Three.js when the whole piece is one custom shader
avoid_when: Scenes with models, lights or cameras: Three.js
Scene classes in a minimal library: OGL

assessment.rationale: npm release Jul 2025, repo pushed Oct 2026; MIT. Thin helper rather than a framework; WebGL only.
